name: stockcurve TSLA/QQQ 0.01sh
description: stockcurve demo pool token: 1 sTSLA-QQ = 0.01 share-unit of a Tesla reference, launched atomically on a Meteora Dynamic Bonding Curve quoted in QQQx (the Nasdaq-100 xStock). Both references come from Pyth Pro live feeds: Equity.US.TSLA/USD for the base and Equity.US.QQQ/USD for the quote, so the curve discovers Tesla's price relative to the Nasdaq-100 with Pyth as the anchor. Hackathon demo (Stocklana 2026), not a claim on Tesla shares.

attributes.value: atomic: create + opening buy in one tx
